findings.source_en: I heard you did it… you killed the Hexapod.
findings.ar: سمعتُ أنك فعلتها... قتلتَ السداسيّ الأرجل.
findings.issue: 05_glossary.csv explicitly freezes Hexapod as الهكسابود (transliterated) and explicitly forbids السداسيّ الأرجل by name, because Merrick has a running mishearing gag built on the transliterated stem (هكسا) elsewhere in the corpus. This row uses exactly the forbidden term, breaking both the glossary lock and the gag setup.
